subject: general
question: India secured the 8th rank in its first-ever participation at the World Skills Asia Competition 2025. How many medals did India win at the event?

options.text: One Silver and two Bronze medals
Two Silver and one Bronze medal
One Gold and two Silver medals

solution:
The correct answer is __**One Silver and two Bronze medals.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India secured the 8th rank in its first-ever participation at the World Skills Asia Competition 2025, held in Chinese Taipei.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **India won a total of three medals: one Silver and two Bronze.**
 
• **Additionally, India earned three Medallions for Excellence across various skill categories.**
 
• **This was India’s debut participation, competing against 29 countries.**
 
• **The achievement showcases the capability and dedication of India’s youth and their trainers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **World Skills Asia Competition 2025**__

 __
 
• Host: Chinese Taipei
 
• Total participating nations: 29
 
• Total competitors: Over 500
 
• Skill categories: 44
 
 
 
• **India’s Delegation**__
 __
 
• Led by: Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
 
• Supported by: NSDC and WorldSkills India
 
 
 
• **Medallions for Excellence**__
 
 
• Awarded to participants who demonstrate high technical skill standards despite not winning a medal.
